question: Should authenticated exact-head AWS lifecycle proof remain mandatory before merge, or should the FakeCo feature owner explicitly waive it for this PR?
rationale: The only remaining blocker concerns real protected-account authorization and destructive lifecycle behavior, which source inspection and local contract tests cannot safely resolve.

options.title: Require live lifecycle proof
options.body: Provide redacted exact-head plan, apply, verify, backup/restore, snapshot, and retained-data teardown artifacts from the dedicated account.

options.title: Grant an item-specific waiver
options.body: The responsible feature owner explicitly accepts the remaining unobserved cloud risk for this exact head.

recommendation.title: Require live lifecycle proof
recommendation.body: Provide redacted exact-head plan, apply, verify, backup/restore, snapshot, and retained-data teardown artifacts from the dedicated account.
